title: Absorption via the best scale-weighted Hoelder constant: C^{0,alpha} and sup bounds on B_{1/2}(0)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l) with the operator norm, g : R^n -> L, and reals alpha, M, A with 0 < alpha <= 1, M >= 0 and A >= 0. Call (y, rho) (y in R^n, rho real) admissible if rho > 0 and |y| + rho <= 1. Assume: (H7') there is a real K0 with ||g(x) - g(x')|| <= K0 |x - x'|^alpha for all x, x' in B_1(0); (P2) for every admissible (y, rho) and every real K such that ||g(x) - g(x')|| <= K |x - x'|^alpha for all x, x' in B_rho(y): rho^{1+alpha} ||g(x) - g(x')|| <= ((1/16) rho^{1+alpha} K + A) |x - x'|^alpha for all x, x' in B_{rho/2}(y); (P3) for every x in R^n and reals r, t, K with |x| + r <= 1, K >= 0, 0 < t < r and ||g(z) - g(z')|| <= K |z - z'|^alpha for all z, z' in B_r(x): ||g(x)|| <= 2M/t + t^alpha K. Then ||g(x)|| <= 1024 M + 64 A and ||g(x) - g(x')|| <= (1024 M + 64 A) |x - x'|^alpha for all x, x' in B_{1/2}(0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (α M A : ℝ), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ A → (∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖g x - g y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ (y : Rn n) (ρ K : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ‖y‖ + ρ ≤ 1 → (∀ x ∈ ball y ρ, ∀ x' ∈ ball y ρ, ‖g x - g x'‖ ≤ K * ‖x - x'‖ ^ α) → ∀ x ∈ ball y (ρ / 2), ∀ x' ∈ ball y (ρ / 2), ρ ^ (1 + α) * ‖g x - g x'‖ ≤ (1 / 16 * ρ ^ (1 + α) * K + A) * ‖x - x'‖ ^ α) → (∀ (x : Rn n) (r t K : ℝ), ‖x‖ + r ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ K → 0 < t → t < r → (∀ z ∈ ball x r, ∀ z' ∈ ball x r, ‖g z - g z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) → ‖g x‖ ≤ 2 * M / t + t ^ α * K) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 / 2), ‖g x‖ ≤ 1024 * M + 64 * A) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 / 2), ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 / 2), ‖g x - g y‖ ≤ (1024 * M + 64 * A) * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
